review.basis: Complete semantic reading of PROTOCOL.md followed by explicit allocation; line spans only locate reviewed clauses. No heading-to-module or keyword inference.
review.preservation: 50 complete clauses preserved verbatim; 6 reviewed changes for install-only bootstrap and deferred scoped assurance; all 56 clause IDs, 37 modules and 64 facets retained.
review.formalization: Structured boundaries refer to complete semantic clauses. They do not decide semantic judgments or manufacture facts. Formal bootstrap guards are necessary checks, not sufficient authorization.
review.coreRationale: Precedence, authority, proportionality, language, consumer exclusions, state separation and evidence invariants apply across routes. Entry/context/workspace add current identity and availability; conditional business modules remain on demand.
review.dependencyRationale: Dependencies are conservative prerequisites from reviewed meaning. Effectful branches add action/security/execution facets even when a request initially seems informational. Context assembly never grants authority. Organizational modeling also selects impact: its structural decision requires the symmetric applicability clause in OOP-impact-propagation. This adds no authority, ticket or organization-type selector; unchanged G0 information/local-write routes stay lightweight. Material coordination selects execution through its actual action facets, alongside CI/change/impact context.
limitations: Semantic review performed by the producing AI; no independent human/second-model approval claimed.
No runtime adapter, provider enrollment or consumer installation executed by this package.
review.current_content: Reviewed current content independent of prior Git graph; longitudinal comparisons require separate attributable evidence.

summaries.OOP-enforcement-autonomy: Bootstrap self-repair reads back configuration without synthetic hook tests; protected dependent effects remain fail-closed until necessary scoped assurance.
summaries.OOP-runtime-adoption: ENF-04/05 retain installed assurance before verified activation/checkpoint advancement while allowing install-only candidate status without bootstrap trials.
summaries.OOP-capability-lifecycle: Producer-reviewed capability selection, shared cumulative dispatch, strongest nonredundant coverage, install/readback only and post-bootstrap evidence reuse/necessary safe assurance. Full suitability remains evidence-bound.
summaries.OOP-interaction-entry: Bootstrap exclusion explicitly bans active hook exercises while preserving necessary post-bootstrap assurance and existing current-workspace entry governance.
summaries.OOP-full-install: BOOT-12 configures once without hook tests; BOOT-13 separates INSTALLED_UNVERIFIED technical completion from unchanged full-readiness predicates. Consumer release exclusion retained.
summaries.OOP-bootstrap-system: SYS-06 defers active installed-path assurance beyond bootstrap, reuses evidence and retains actual effect admission and scoped invalidation.
